findings.title: Approved RoE is 16 % of the opening equity; Reg. 3.6.4 as the order quotes it says the normative average equity of the year
findings.detail: Table 77 computes each DISCOM's equity as the reserve price plus 30 % of the assets put to use up to FY2025-26, and RoE as 16 % of it (TPWODL: 300.00 + 596.58 = 896.58; 143.45) — exact for all four.  The order quotes Reg. 3.6.4: 'The return on equity shall be calculated on the normative average equity of the year.'  The DISCOMs' proposals (Table 76) did take the average — 16 % on the opening balance and on half the year's additions (TPWODL 160.99 + 13.91).  The approval leaves out the year's additions altogether.  For the reviewer: whether the reserve-price construction (Reg. 3.6.1) displaces 3.6.4's average for the approval.
where: OERC order on the Odisha DISCOMs FY2026-27, pp.169–170 Tables 76, 77; Regs. 3.6.1, 3.6.4, 3.5.2 (b) as quoted

findings.title: TPCODL's proposed RoE: its rows add to 171.20 (155.84 + 15.36); Table 76 prints 171.14
findings.detail: 16 % of the opening 974.00 is 155.84 and 16 % of half the additions 192.03 is 15.36, both as printed; their sum is 171.20, against the total 171.14.  The other three DISCOMs' rows add to their totals.  A question on the proposal as the order reports it; it does not reach the approval (151.56).
where: OERC order on the Odisha DISCOMs FY2026-27, p.169 Table 76
